name: Shibasen
source:
「I will move forward… to the future where everyone can smile happily」

An alternate history administrator apprentice studying under his master, Taiitsu Shinjin, in the Celestial Realm.

One day, he has a vision of a "doomed future" and descends to the lower world to preserve the alternate history in lieu of his ailing master.

After concealing his true identity, the Ryuuhou Army welcomed him in as a "Guide of Heaven" to guide the Red Dragon.

At first, he interacts with the heroines to fulfill his duties as an administrator, but as he interacts with them, he chooses to correct this history in order to "save the people he cares about from destruction."

He is sensitive, yet once he makes a decision, he acts quickly. He is also a dedicated worker who often takes on extra responsibilities.
